nodes.label: summarizePeriod
nodes.rationale: One function in packages/profit-engine/src/period.ts turns a period's stored sums into every Overview, Profit, Marketing, Products, profit-and-loss, CSV, PDF, and scheduled-email figure. Nothing else adds up revenue, costs, advertising, or expenses.

nodes.label: Revenue
nodes.rationale: Revenue is net sales plus shipping charged net of refunds. Net sales are gross sales minus discounts minus product refunds. Tax is never revenue.

nodes.label: Contribution Profit
nodes.rationale: Contribution before advertising is revenue minus product cost, payment fees, and shipping cost. Advertising is subtracted only when advertising data exists; otherwise profit excludes advertising and says so. Platform-reported sales stay apart from Shopify revenue and spend is not allocated to products or orders.

nodes.label: Estimated Net Profit
nodes.rationale: Estimated net profit is contribution profit minus operating expenses only when expenses are set up. Otherwise the figure is not available, so a partial contribution is not labelled as accounting-grade net profit.

nodes.label: Data Status
nodes.rationale: Zero is not missing. An amount is never inferred. Statuses are confirmed (including a confirmed zero), estimated, missing, not_configured, and not_applicable. The weakest entry wins. Exports write words such as Missing instead of 0 so a spreadsheet cannot read a gap as zero.

nodes.label: Cash View Refunds
nodes.rationale: A refund counts on its processed date in the shop time zone, not the order date and not the settlement date. Past months stay unchanged. Discounts are not taken off twice. Payment fees are not returned because the Admin API does not expose a reversed fee. Restocked goods bring cost back on the refund date.

nodes.label: Frozen Ledger Unit Cost
nodes.rationale: Each line's cost is frozen in the ledger. Resolution order is the earlier calculation, then the latest merchant cost on or before the order date, then Shopify's current unit cost as Estimated, otherwise Missing never zero. Changing a cost today does not rewrite earlier orders. Only an explicit audited recalculate does; fill gaps prices only lines that were missing.

nodes.label: Decimal Money
nodes.rationale: Money uses decimal.js in code and numeric(19,4) in the database. Each ledger entry is rounded once, half away from zero, to the currency minor unit. Floating point is never used for money.
